correctness.rationale: The exact definition of Gamma_n as no-consecutive-one bitstrings and compatibility as all four cross-endpoint Hamming distances >1 correctly reduces induced matchings to cliques of a 130-vertex graph at n=8. A greedy proper coloring gives certified upper bounds at each branch; strict-less-than-best pruning preserves all tied optima. A fresh independently written exact bitset clique branch-and-bound returned maxima and number of optimums for every n=1..8, including n8: 55 vertices, 130 edges, maximum 12, exactly 12 optima, 10283 recursion nodes. Bit reversal is an automorphism, and the source proof fixes zero and singleton vertices to show automorphism group of Gamma_8 has just identity and reversal; the twelve optima pair into six free orbits. Not a nonexhaustive finite sample.

value.rationale: The natural induced matching (strong matching) invariant of the widely studied Fibonacci cube has an exact finite first deviation from a simple observed Fibonacci pattern; all 12 optimum configurations and six natural symmetry types are classified. Although no all-n theorem follows and the pattern was not a published conjecture, this self-contained exact n=8 natural invariant is independently useful for extremal graph databases and strong-coloring comparisons.
